question.ar: هل وُجّه إعذار إلى المدعى عليه قبل رفع الدعوى؟
question.en: Was a formal notice sent to the defendant before the claim?

help.ar: الإعذار: إنذار رسمي بالوفاء أو بالتنفيذ، عادة عن طريق محضر قضائي.
help.en: A formal notice: an official demand to pay or to perform, usually served by a bailiff.

question.ar: ما تاريخ تبليغ الإعذار؟
question.en: On what date was the formal notice served?

question.ar: بأي وسيلة وُجّه الإعذار؟
question.en: By what means was the formal notice sent?

label.ar: محضر قضائي
label.en: A bailiff

label.ar: رسالة مضمونة مع إشعار بالاستلام
label.en: A registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt

label.ar: وسيلة أخرى
label.en: Another means

question.ar: هل حرر مكتب المصالحة محضرا بعدم المصالحة؟
question.en: Did the conciliation office draw up a record of non-conciliation?

question.ar: ما تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم المصالحة؟
question.en: On what date was the non-conciliation record delivered?

help.ar: تاريخ التسليم، لا تاريخ المحضر ولا تاريخ الجلسة.
help.en: The date of delivery, not the date of the record or of the hearing.

question.ar: ما تاريخ إبرام العقد؟
question.en: On what date was the contract made?

help.ar: في الإيجار التجاري يحدد هذا التاريخ النظام المطبق: قبل تعديل 2005 أو بعده.
help.en: For a commercial lease this date decides which regime applies: before or after the 2005 reform.

question.ar: هل أحد الأطراف هو الدولة أو ولاية أو بلدية أو مؤسسة عمومية ذات طابع إداري؟
question.en: Is one of the parties the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body?

question.ar: هل العقار مشهر بالمحافظة العقارية؟
question.en: Is the property published at the land registry?

question.ar: ما تاريخ استحقاق أقدم أجر مطالب به؟
question.en: On what date did the oldest wage claimed fall due?

question.ar: هل يقيم المدعى عليه خارج التراب الوطني؟
question.en: Does the defendant live outside the national territory?

question.ar: هل صاحب العمل في حالة إفلاس أو تسوية قضائية؟
question.en: Is the employer bankrupt or in judicial settlement?

question.ar: هل المدعي موظف أو عون خاضع للقانون الأساسي للمؤسسات والإدارات العمومية؟
question.en: Is the plaintiff a civil servant or an agent under the statute of public institutions and administrations?

question.ar: هل أنهي عقد العمل أو علق بسبب حادث عمل أو مرض مهني؟
question.en: Was the employment contract ended or suspended because of a work accident or an occupational illness?

question.ar: هل ينص العقد على أن المدين يعتبر معذرا بمجرد حلول الأجل دون حاجة إلى أي إجراء آخر؟
question.en: Does the contract say that the debtor is in default by the mere arrival of the due date, without any further step?

question.ar: هل أصبح تنفيذ الالتزام متعذرا أو غير مجد بفعل المدين؟
question.en: Has performance of the obligation become impossible or useless through the debtor's own act?

question.ar: هل محل الالتزام المطالب به تعويض ترتب عن عمل مضر؟
question.en: Is the obligation claimed compensation arising from a harmful act?

question.ar: هل محل الالتزام رد شيء يعلم المدين أنه مسروق، أو شيء تسلمه دون حق وهو عالم بذلك؟
question.en: Is the obligation to return a thing the debtor knows was stolen, or a thing he received without right knowing it?

question.ar: هل صرح المدين كتابة بأنه لا ينوي تنفيذ التزامه؟
question.en: Has the debtor declared in writing that he does not intend to perform?

question.ar: هل المدعي هو البائع في بيع عروض أو منقولات عين فيه أجل لدفع الثمن وتسلم المبيع، وحل الأجل دون دفع الثمن، دون اتفاق على خلاف ذلك؟
question.en: Is the plaintiff the seller in a sale of goods or other movables with a fixed term for paying the price and taking delivery, which passed with the price unpaid, and no agreement to the contrary?

question.ar: هل الإيجار إيجار محل تجاري يخضع لأحكام الإيجار في القانون التجاري؟
question.en: Is the lease a lease of business premises governed by the lease provisions of the Commercial Code?

question.ar: هل يحدد العقد شكلا أو أجلا أو جهة معينة للإعذار قبل المطالبة أو الفسخ أو حلول الدين؟
question.en: Does the contract set a form, a period or an addressee for the notice before a claim, a rescission or the acceleration of the debt?

question.ar: هل بلغ الإعذار إلى المدين قبل يوم رفع الدعوى، لا في يومه ولا بعده؟
question.en: Was the notice served on the debtor before the day the petition is filed, not on that day or after it?

question.ar: ما تاريخ استحقاق الدين المطالب به (أقدم مبلغ إن تعددت المبالغ)؟
question.en: On what date did the debt claimed fall due (the oldest sum, if there are several)?

slots.why: Deadlines d1, d6, d7 and d8 run from it: limitation starts on the day the debt becomes due when no special text applies (civil-code 315 ¶1). No existing slot holds it: wages_due_from holds only wages, contract_date is the day of the contract. Same fact as derivation A's obligation_due_date and derivation B's debt_due_date.

question.ar: ما تاريخ وقوع الفعل الضار؟
question.en: On what date did the harmful act occur?

slots.why: Deadline d2 runs from it: the compensation action falls after fifteen years from the day of the harmful act (civil-code 133 ¶1). Proposed under the same id by both derivations.

question.ar: هل صدر أمر من رئيس الجهة القضائية برفع السقوط بسبب قوة قاهرة أو أحداث أثرت في السير العادي لمرفق العدالة؟
question.en: Has the president of the court lifted the forfeiture by order, for force majeure or events that disturbed the normal working of the courts?

slots.why: Deadline d5 reads it: every period of the CPCA for exercising a right is forfeited when missed, except for force majeure or events affecting the courts, and the forfeiture is lifted by the president's order on petition (cpca 322 ¶1 and ¶2). Unknown, it is not asked and the deadline applies.

question.ar: هل يتمسك المدعي بقوة قاهرة أو بأحداث أثرت في السير العادي لمرفق العدالة حالت دون رفع الدعوى في أجلها، مع طلب رفع السقوط إلى رئيس الجهة القضائية؟
question.en: Does the plaintiff rely on force majeure, or on events that disturbed the normal working of the courts, that kept him from filing in time, with a request to the president of the court to lift the forfeiture?

slots.why: Deadlines d5 and d9 read it (verifier, attack atk-9): the forfeiture of cpca 322 ¶1 does not fall in case of force majeure or events affecting the courts, and the request to lift it goes to the president of the court before which the dispute is brought (cpca 322 ¶2), so the order cannot exist before the petition is filed. Unknown, it is not asked and d5 applies.

question.ar: هل الدين أتعاب أو مصاريف مستحقة عن عمل المهنة لطبيب (ومنه الجراح وجراح الأسنان) أو قابلة أو صيدلي أو محام أو مهندس (ومنه المهندس المعماري) أو خبير أو وكيل تفليسة أو سمسار أو أستاذ أو معلم أو مرب؟
question.en: Is the debt a fee or expense owed for the work of his profession to a doctor (including a surgeon or dental surgeon), midwife, pharmacist, lawyer, engineer (including an architect), expert, bankruptcy agent, broker, professor, teacher or educator?

slots.why: Deadline d6 reads it: these rights are time-barred after two years (civil-code 310 ¶1). The question also names the professions that only the French edition of the same Official Journal issue lists (surgeons, dental surgeons, midwives, architects, educators): the protective reading of open point o11 (verifier, attack adv-6).

question.ar: هل الدين ثمن أشياء ورّدها تاجر أو صانع لشخص لا يتجر فيها، أو أجر إقامة أو ثمن طعام لدى فندق أو مطعم؟
question.en: Is the debt the price of things supplied by a trader or craftsman to a person who does not trade in them, or a hotel's or restaurant's charge for lodging or meals?

slots.why: Deadline d7 reads it: these rights are time-barred after one year (civil-code 312 ¶1 and ¶2).

question.ar: هل الدين حق دوري متجدد غير الأجور المطالب بها، كأجرة المباني أو الديون المتأخرة أو المعاشات، وليس ريعا مستحقا في ذمة حائز سيء النية أو ريعا واجبا على متصرف المال المشاع للمستحقين؟
question.en: Is the debt a periodic renewable right other than the wages claimed, such as rent of buildings, arrears or pensions, and not revenue owed by a possessor in bad faith or by the manager of jointly owned property to those entitled?

slots.why: Deadline d8 reads it: every periodic renewable right is time-barred after five years even if acknowledged (civil-code 309 ¶1). Wages, also named there, are carried by d4 from wages_due_from, so the question leaves them out. Revenue owed by a bad-faith possessor or by the manager of jointly owned property falls only after fifteen years (civil-code 309 ¶2), so the question leaves it out too and d1 governs it (verifier, attack atk-6).

question.ar: هل أنشئ في المحكمة التي سترفع أمامها الدعوى القسم الذي ينظر في هذا النوع من النزاع (أجب بـ«لا» أيضا إذا لم تنشأ في المحكمة أقسام أصلا، أو إذا دمج أمر رئيس المحكمة هذا القسم في قسم آخر)؟
question.en: Has the court where the claim will be filed created the section that hears this kind of dispute? (Answer no also when the court has no sections at all, or when an order of the court president has merged that section into another.)

slots.why: The section rule (its alternative after the social one) and exit x3 read it: cpca 32 ¶5 keeps every dispute except social cases with the civil section in courts where the sections have not been created. Same fact as derivation A's court_has_sections and derivation B's court_has_section_for_matter; the wider wording is kept so that both readings of ¶5 (no sections at all, or not the section concerned) are covered (open point o7). Verifier: the court president may reduce the number of sections by order (Organic Law 22-10 art. 21, not in the store; o6, o7), hence the merged case in the question.

question.ar: هل النزاع ناشئ عن علاقة عمل أو عقد تكوين أو تمهين (إثباته أو تنفيذه أو تعليقه أو إنهاؤه)، أو هو من منازعات الضمان الاجتماعي والتقاعد، أو انتخاب مندوبي العمال، أو الحق النقابي، أو الإضراب، أو الاتفاقيات الجماعية للعمل؟
question.en: Does the dispute arise from an employment, training or apprenticeship relationship (its proof, performance, suspension or termination), or is it a social-security or retirement dispute, or one on staff-delegate elections, union rights, strikes or collective labour agreements?

slots.why: The social alternative of the section rule, exit x3 and boundary n7 read it: cpca 500 ¶1-¶8 give the social section exclusive jurisdiction over all these matters, not only wages and reinstatement (attack adv-5).

question.ar: هل النزاع من مسائل الأسرة: الخطبة أو الزواج أو انحلاله وتوابعه (ومنها الصداق ومتاع بيت الزوجية)، أو إثبات الزواج أو النسب، أو الكفالة، أو الولاية أو الحجر أو الغياب أو الفقدان أو التقديم؟
question.en: Is the dispute a family matter: engagement, marriage, its dissolution and consequences (dowry and household goods included), proof of marriage or filiation, kafala, guardianship, interdiction, absence, disappearance or curatorship?

slots.why: The family alternative of the section rule reads it: cpca 423 ¶1-¶6 give these claims to the family section and cpca 426 ¶7 and ¶9 fix the court for household goods and dowry, matters no request kind of the rule covered (attack adv-7).

question.ar: هل القسمة المطلوبة قسمة تركة؟
question.en: Is the partition asked for the partition of an estate?

slots.why: Boundary n8 reads it: cpca 512 ¶10 gives partition to the real-estate section while cpca 498 and 499 place estate claims in the family-section chapter (attack adv-6, open point o12).

question.ar: هل أحد أطراف الدعوى هيئة عمومية وطنية أو منظمة مهنية وطنية؟
question.en: Is one of the parties a national public institution or a national professional organisation?

slots.why: Exit x4 reads it: the amended cpca 800 ¶2 also gives the administrative courts the cases in which these bodies are a party, which the existing slot public_body_party does not ask (attack atk-4, open point o9).

question.ar: هل يتعلق النزاع بعقار أو بحق عيني عقاري (ملكية، حيازة، شيوع، قسمة، إيجار سكن أو محل مهني، حقوق مترتبة على عقد مشهر)؟
question.en: Does the dispute concern real property or a real right in it (ownership, possession, co-ownership, partition, lease of a dwelling or professional premises, rights under a published deed)?

slots.why: The section rule reads it to propose the real-estate section: cpca 511 ¶1, 512 and 515 ¶1 give that section the disputes about real property. property_registered only asks whether a property is published. Proposed by derivation A only.

question.ar: هل النزاع تجاري (بين تجار أو متعلق بعمل تجاري)؟
question.en: Is the dispute commercial (between merchants, or about a commercial act)?

slots.why: The section rule reads it to propose the commercial section: cpca 531 ¶1 gives that section the commercial disputes. commercial_lease covers only leases of business premises. Proposed by derivation A only.

question.ar: هل النزاع من المنازعات التي تختص بها المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة: الملكية الفكرية، أو الشركات التجارية (الشركاء، الحل، التصفية)، أو التسوية القضائية والإفلاس، أو البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار، أو النقل البحري والجوي والتأمينات المتعلقة بالنشاط التجاري، أو التجارة الدولية؟
question.en: Is the dispute one the specialised commercial court hears: intellectual property, commercial companies (partners, dissolution, liquidation), judicial settlement and bankruptcy, banks and financial institutions against traders, maritime, air transport and insurance linked to commercial activity, or international trade?

slots.why: Exit x2 reads it: cpca 531 ¶1 excepts from the commercial section the disputes cpca 536 مكرر ¶1-7 gives to the specialised commercial court. Proposed by derivation B only.

question.ar: هل الدعوى دعوى مسؤولية ترمي إلى تعويض أضرار ناجمة عن مركبة تابعة للدولة أو لولاية أو بلدية أو مؤسسة عمومية ذات صبغة إدارية؟
question.en: Is the claim a liability claim for compensation of damage caused by a vehicle belonging to the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body?

slots.why: Exit x1 and boundary n1 read it: cpca 802 ¶1 and ¶3 keep these claims with the ordinary courts although a public body is a party. Same fact as derivation A's public_vehicle_damage and derivation B's claim_is_vehicle_damage_by_public_body.

question.ar: هل يندرج النزاع ضمن إحدى المواد التي تختص بها المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة؟ وأيها؟
question.en: Does the dispute fall in one of the matters of the specialised commercial court, and which one?

label.ar: منازعات الملكية الفكرية
label.en: Intellectual property

label.ar: منازعات الشركات التجارية، لا سيما منازعات الشركاء وحل وتصفية الشركات
label.en: Commercial companies, in particular disputes between partners and the dissolution and liquidation of companies

label.ar: التسوية القضائية والإفلاس
label.en: Judicial settlement and bankruptcy

label.ar: منازعات البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار
label.en: Banks and financial institutions with merchants

label.ar: المنازعات البحرية والنقل الجوي ومنازعات التأمينات المتعلقة بالنشاط التجاري
label.en: Maritime, air transport, and insurance disputes linked to commercial activity

label.ar: المنازعات المتعلقة بالتجارة الدولية
label.en: International trade

label.ar: لا شيء مما سبق
label.en: None of these

slots.why: Exit x4 and territory rule t2 read it: cpca 536 مكرر ¶1 to ¶7 list the matters of the specialised commercial court, and cpca 531 ¶1 takes them out of the commercial section. Proposed under this id by both derivations; choice ids bankruptcy_settlement = B's insolvency, bank_with_merchant = B's bank_against_trader.

question.ar: هل تهدف الدعوى إلى إلغاء قرار إداري أو تفسيره أو فحص مشروعيته؟
question.en: Does the claim seek to annul, interpret or review the legality of an administrative decision?

slots.why: Exit x3, deadlines d1 and d2, territory rule t4 and document doc2 read it when the petition asks to cancel a decision: cpca 801 ¶2 to ¶6 and 900 مكرر ¶3 turn on a decision of an administrative authority. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: ما تاريخ التبليغ الشخصي بالقرار الإداري الفردي، أو تاريخ نشر القرار الجماعي أو التنظيمي؟
question.en: On what date was the individual administrative decision personally notified, or the collective or regulatory decision published?

slots.why: Deadline d1 starts from it: cpca 829 ¶1. Same fact as derivation A's decision_notified_on and derivation B's administrative_decision_notice_date.

question.ar: هل قدم تظلم إلى الجهة الإدارية مصدرة القرار؟
question.en: Was a grievance lodged with the administrative authority that made the decision?

slots.why: Deadlines d1 and d2 and document doc3 read it: cpca 830 ¶1 to ¶4 replace the period of 829 by a new one once a grievance is lodged. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: ما تاريخ تبليغ رد الإدارة الرافض للتظلم؟
question.en: On what date was the administration's refusal of the grievance notified?

slots.why: Deadline d2 starts from it: cpca 830 ¶4. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: هل توجد شكوى أو دعوى عمومية جارية، أو صدر حكم جزائي، بشأن الوقائع التي تقوم عليها الدعوى؟
question.en: Is there a complaint or a public prosecution pending, or has a criminal judgment been given, on the facts the claim rests on?

slots.why: Exit x6 reads it: civil-code 339 ¶1 binds the civil judge to what a criminal judgment necessarily decided. Same fact as derivation A's criminal_case_on_same_facts and derivation B's criminal_proceedings_pending (the question joins both wordings).

question.ar: هل الضرر المطالب بتعويضه ناتج عن جناية أو جنحة أو مخالفة؟
question.en: Is the damage claimed the result of a felony, a misdemeanour or a minor offence?

slots.why: Exit x6 reads it (derivation B's reading, kept as the protective one while the Code of Criminal Procedure is not in the store): cpca 39 ¶3 names damage from an offence apart from other torts.

question.ar: هل الدين المطالب به مبلغ من النقود مستحق وحال الأداء ومعين المقدار وثابت بالكتابة (اعتراف بدين أو تعهد بالوفاء أو فاتورة مؤشر عليها من المدين)؟
question.en: Is the debt claimed a sum of money that is due, payable now, of a fixed amount, and proven in writing (an acknowledgement of debt, an undertaking to pay, or an invoice endorsed by the debtor)?

slots.why: Exit x7, territory rule t3 and document doc1 read it: cpca 306 ¶1 opens the order-to-pay route for such a debt. Derivation A's id; it holds the two facts of derivation B's debt_is_fixed_sum_money_due and debt_proved_in_writing together, as the paragraph sets them as one condition.

question.ar: هل صدر أمر بالأداء ضد المدين بشأن هذا الدين؟
question.en: Has an order to pay already been issued against the debtor for this debt?

slots.why: Deadlines d3 and d4 read it: cpca 308 ¶3 and 309 ¶1 and ¶2. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: ما تاريخ صدور أمر الأداء؟
question.en: On what date was the order to pay issued?

slots.why: Deadline d3 starts from it: cpca 309 ¶2. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: ما تاريخ التبليغ الرسمي لأمر الأداء إلى المدين؟
question.en: On what date was the order to pay formally served on the debtor?

slots.why: Deadline d4 starts from it: cpca 308 ¶3. Derivation B's id.

question.ar: هل قدم التظلم إلى الجهة الإدارية خلال أربعة أشهر من التبليغ الشخصي بالقرار أو من نشره؟
question.en: Was the grievance lodged with the administration within four months of the personal notification or the publication of the decision?

slots.why: Deadlines d1, d2 and d5 read it: cpca 830 ¶1 allows the grievance only «في الأجل المنصوص عليه في المادة 829»; a late grievance opens no new period, so d1 keeps running (verifier, attacks adv-1 and atk-5).

question.ar: ما تاريخ تبليغ التظلم إلى الجهة الإدارية (تاريخ استلامها له)؟
question.en: On what date was the grievance notified to (received by) the administration?

slots.why: Deadline d5 starts from it: cpca 830 ¶2 «ويبدأ هذا الأجل من تاريخ تبليغ التظلم» and ¶3 (verifier, attacks adv-1 and atk-4).

question.ar: هل بلغت الإدارة رفضها للتظلم خلال شهرين من تاريخ تبليغ التظلم إليها؟
question.en: Did the administration notify its refusal of the grievance within two months of the grievance being notified to it?

slots.why: Deadlines d2 and d5 read it: cpca 830 ¶4 starts the period from the notified refusal only «في حالة رد الجهة الإدارية خلال الأجل الممنوح لها»; otherwise ¶2 and ¶3 (silence) govern (verifier, attack adv-1).

question.ar: ما الجهة التي أصدرت القرار الإداري المطعون فيه؟
question.en: Which authority made the contested administrative decision?

label.ar: جهة محلية أو جهوية: الولاية أو المصالح غير الممركزة للدولة على مستوى الولاية أو البلدية أو منظمة مهنية جهوية أو مؤسسة عمومية محلية ذات صبغة إدارية
label.en: A local or regional authority: the wilaya, the decentralised State services at wilaya level, the commune, a regional professional organisation or a local public administrative body

label.ar: سلطة إدارية مركزية أو هيئة عمومية وطنية أو منظمة مهنية وطنية
label.en: A central administrative authority, a national public body or a national professional organisation

slots.why: Territory rule t4 reads it: cpca 900 مكرر ¶3 gives the administrative court of appeal of Algiers only the decisions of central authorities, national public bodies and national professional organisations; cpca 801 ¶2 to ¶6 leave local decisions to the administrative courts (verifier, attack atk-2).

question.ar: هل استنفد العامل إجراءات المعالجة الداخلية للنزاع داخل الهيئة المستخدمة (إجراءات الاتفاقية الجماعية، أو عرض الأمر على الرئيس المباشر ثم على الهيئة المسيرة أو المستخدم)؟
question.en: Did the worker first exhaust the internal procedure for handling the dispute inside the employer (the collective agreement's procedure or, failing it, referral to the direct superior and then to management or the employer)?

slots.why: Prior step p2 reads it: articles 2, 3, 4 and 5 of the law on individual labour disputes put the referral to the labour inspector after the internal procedure is exhausted. Derivation A's internal_grievance_exhausted and derivation B's internal_settlement_attempted, merged.

question.ar: هل حرر مكتب المصالحة محضر مصالحة باتفاق الطرفين على كل الخلاف أو جزء منه؟
question.en: Did the conciliation office draw up a record of conciliation, the parties having agreed on all or part of the dispute?

slots.why: Boundary n1 reads it: articles 31, 33 and 34 of the law on individual labour disputes and CPCA articles 508 and 509 send the non-execution of a conciliation agreement to the president of the social section for immediate execution, not to an ordinary claim.

question.ar: هل سبق أن سلم محضر عدم مصالحة آخر عن نفس النزاع قبل المحضر المذكور؟
question.en: Was an earlier non-conciliation record delivered for the same dispute, before the record entered?

slots.why: Deadline d3 reads it: the Supreme Court (social chamber, file 1488919, 07-10-2021), reading CPCA 504 and 69, runs the six months from the first non-conciliation record and holds that a second record on the same dispute cannot be obtained (verifier, attack adv-1).

question.ar: ما تاريخ تسليم محضر عدم المصالحة الأول عن نفس النزاع؟
question.en: On what date was the first non-conciliation record for the same dispute delivered?

slots.why: Deadline d3 runs from it (CPCA 504 as read by the Supreme Court, file 1488919, 07-10-2021; attack adv-1).

question.ar: هل يطالب العامل بأجور عن فترة لاحقة لتسريحه؟
question.en: Does the worker claim pay for a period after his dismissal?

slots.why: Boundary n1 reads it: Law 90-11 article 80 paragraph 1 ties the wage to work performed, while article 73-4 paragraph 1 grants a worker dismissed in breach of procedure a compensation measured on the wage he would have earned had he gone on working; pay claimed for a period after a dismissal belongs to the dismissal claim. A suspension without dismissal is not covered: article 73-4 concerns dismissal only (open point o13).

question.ar: هل يقل مرتب العامل عن ضعف الأجر الوطني الأدنى المضمون؟
question.en: Is the worker's pay below twice the national guaranteed minimum wage?

slots.why: Document doc3 reads it: Law 90-04 article 25 paragraph 1 grants legal aid as of right to a worker whose pay is below twice the guaranteed minimum wage, and CPCA article 417 paragraph 2 exempts a beneficiary from court costs.

question.ar: ما تاريخ تسريح المدعي أو فصله من العمل (تاريخ تبليغ قرار التسريح، أو تاريخ منعه فعلا من العمل إن لم يصدر قرار مكتوب)؟
question.en: On what date was the plaintiff dismissed (the date the dismissal decision was notified, or the date he was in fact kept from work when no written decision was given)?

slots.why: Element e2 reads it (event dismissal); labour-relations 73-4 ¶1 measures the compensation for a procedural breach on the pay the worker would have received had he stayed at work, which runs from this date. Proposed by both derivations (same id).

question.ar: هل بلغ قرار التسريح إلى العامل كتابة؟
question.en: Was the dismissal decision notified to the worker in writing?

slots.why: Boundary n3 and elements e2 and e3 read it; labour-relations 73-2 ¶2 requires the procedure to provide for written notification, and 73-4 ¶1 attaches its own remedy to a breach of the procedure. Proposed by derivation B.

question.ar: هل استمع المستخدم إلى العامل قبل تسريحه؟
question.en: Did the employer hear the worker before the dismissal?

slots.why: Boundary n3 and elements e2 and e3 read it; labour-relations 73-2 ¶2 requires the procedure to provide for the employer to hear the worker, and 73-4 ¶1 attaches its own remedy to a breach of the procedure. Proposed by derivation B.

question.ar: في أي شكل أبرم عقد الإيجار؟
question.en: In what form was the lease made?

label.ar: عقد رسمي (محرر لدى موثق)
label.en: An official deed (drawn up by a notary)

label.ar: عقد عرفي ثابت التاريخ (مسجل أو مؤشر عليه من ضابط عمومي)
label.en: A private written contract with a fixed date (registered, or endorsed by a public officer)

label.ar: عقد عرفي مكتوب غير ثابت التاريخ
label.en: A private written contract without a fixed date

label.ar: إيجار شفهي دون كتابة
label.en: An oral lease, with nothing in writing

slots.why: Boundaries n1 and n2 read it: civil-code 467 مكرر makes a lease void unless written with a fixed date (328 says when a private contract's date is fixed), and civil-code 324 مكرر 1 and commercial-code 187 مكرر require the official form for commercial leases on pain of nullity. It replaces derivation B's lease_in_writing_with_certain_date and commercial_lease_in_official_form.

question.ar: هل يتضمن عقد الإيجار شرطا يقضي بفسخه بقوة القانون عند عدم دفع بدل الإيجار في مواعيده؟
question.en: Does the lease contain a clause that rescinds it by law if the rent is not paid on the agreed dates?

slots.why: Prior step p1 reads it: Commercial Code 191 gives such a clause in a commercial lease effect only one month after an unanswered demand to pay that mentions the period.

question.ar: هل وجه إلى المستأجر إخطار بالدفع يذكر مهلة الشهر، ومضى شهر كامل من تبليغه دون دفع قبل تاريخ العريضة؟
question.en: Was the tenant served with a demand to pay that mentions the one-month period, and had a full month passed since it without payment before the petition's date?

slots.why: Prior step p1 (its own slot) reads it: Commercial Code 191 ¶1 and ¶2.

question.ar: هل أودعت عريضة الدعوى للإشهار بالمحافظة العقارية، أو سيقدم ما يثبت إيداعها في أول جلسة؟
question.en: Has the petition been lodged for publication at the land registry, or will proof of lodging be shown at the first hearing?

slots.why: Prior step p2 (its own slot) reads it: cpca 17 ¶3 requires publication of a petition relating to a published immovable or real right, on pain of formal inadmissibility unless its lodging for publication is proved. It replaces derivation B's petition_published_at_land_registry.

question.ar: هل انقضى الأجل المتفق عليه في عقد الإيجار قبل رفع الدعوى، ولو بقي المستأجر في العين بعده أو لم يوجه إليه تنبيه بالإخلاء؟
question.en: Did the term agreed in the lease end before the claim is filed, even if the tenant stayed on or no notice to quit was served?

slots.why: Boundaries n3 and n9 read it: Civil Code 469 مكرر 1 and Commercial Code 187 مكرر ¶2 end the lease at its term, after which Civil Code 502 gives compensation for holding over rather than rent; Commercial Code 173 ends a commercial lease made before law 05-02 only by a notice to quit, failing which a written lease continues by tacit extension.

question.ar: هل الإيجار إيجار سكني مبرم مع مؤسسة عمومية مختصة في السكن؟
question.en: Is the lease a residential lease made with a competent public housing institution?

slots.why: Boundary n4 reads it: Civil Code 507 مكرر 1 keeps such leases under their own special provisions.

question.ar: ما محل الإيجار؟
question.en: What is leased?

label.ar: مسكن أو محل مهني أو محل تجاري
label.en: A dwelling, professional premises or business premises

label.ar: أرض أو مستثمرة فلاحية (إيجار فلاحي)
label.en: Agricultural land or a farm (an agricultural lease)

label.ar: تسيير محل تجاري أو مؤسسة صناعية (عقد تسيير)
label.en: The running of a business or industrial establishment (a management contract)

label.ar: عقار آخر (أرض أو مستودع أو غيرهما)
label.en: Another immovable (land, a warehouse or the like)

label.ar: منقول (مركبة أو آلة أو عتاد أو غيرها)
label.en: A movable (a vehicle, machine, equipment or the like)

slots.why: Boundary n10, the section rule and territory rule t1 read it: a lease may be of any thing (civil-code 467 ¶1); civil-code 324 مكرر 1 ¶1 requires the official form for agricultural leases and business-management contracts; cpca 512 ¶11 and ¶12 give the real-estate section leases of dwellings, professional premises and agricultural leases, and cpca 40 ¶2 reaches only lease actions relating to immovables, so a movable's lease follows cpca 32 ¶4 and 37 ¶1.

question.ar: هل تشمل الفترات المطالب بها فترات لاحقة لانقضاء الأجل المتفق عليه في العقد؟
question.en: Do the periods claimed include periods after the agreed term of the lease ended?

slots.why: Boundaries n3 and n9 read it: rent that fell due during the term is owed as rent under civil-code 498 ¶1, while civil-code 502 ¶1 speaks of keeping the property after the end of the term.

question.ar: هل صدر حكم بإفلاس المستأجر أو بتسويته القضائية أو بتصفيته القضائية؟
question.en: Has a judgment opened bankruptcy, judicial settlement or judicial liquidation against the tenant?

slots.why: Boundary n11 reads it: commercial-code 201 ¶1 keeps the lease of premises used for trade, industry or crafts despite the tenant's bankruptcy or judicial liquidation and voids a contrary clause; cpca 536 مكرر ¶4 gives judicial settlement and bankruptcy to the specialised commercial court.

question.ar: منذ أي تاريخ توقف المدعى عليه عن الإنفاق؟
question.en: Since what date has the defendant stopped maintaining?

slots.why: Deadline d1 and element e5 read it: family-code article 80 lets the judge award maintenance for no more than a year before filing. Same id in A and B.

question.ar: لمن تطلب النفقة؟
question.en: For whom is maintenance claimed?

label.ar: للزوجة أو المطلقة وحدها
label.en: The wife or former wife only

label.ar: للأولاد وحدهم (يطالب الحاضن أو الولي باسمهم)
label.en: The children only (the custodian or guardian claims in their name)

label.ar: للزوجة أو المطلقة وللأولاد
label.en: The wife or former wife and the children

label.ar: لأصل أو فرع (والد، أو ولد بالغ لا يزاول الدراسة وغير عاجز)
label.en: An ascendant or descendant (a parent, or an adult child who is neither studying nor disabled)

slots.why: Boundaries n3, n5, n6, n9, documents doc3, doc7, doc9, doc10 and elements e2, e4 read it: family-code 74 and 61 (wife), 75 and 87 (children) and 77 (ascendants and descendants) set different conditions. Merges A's maintenance_for and B's maintenance_creditor; whether the marriage was dissolved is held by spouses_divorced.

question.ar: هل وقع الدخول بالزوجة أو الدعوة إليه، وهل تقوم على ذلك بينة؟
question.en: Was the marriage consummated, or was there a call (دعوتها) to consummate it, and can it be proved?

slots.why: Boundary n6, element e2 and document doc7 read it: family-code article 74 makes the wife's maintenance due upon consummation or the call to it, on evidence. Merges A's consummation_or_invitation and B's wife_entered_or_called_with_proof; the question keeps the text's own word because the text does not say who makes the call (open point o10).

question.ar: هل وقع الطلاق بين الطرفين بحكم؟
question.en: Has a divorce between the parties been pronounced by judgment?

slots.why: Requests r3, r4, r5, boundaries n5, n9, documents doc2, doc10 and elements e3, e4 read it: family-code articles 61 and 72 apply after divorce, 87 paragraph 3 moves guardianship on divorce. Holds the fact B carried in the choice divorced_wife of maintenance_creditor.

question.ar: هل الزواج مسجل في سجل الحالة المدنية؟
question.en: Is the marriage registered in the civil-status register?

slots.why: Boundary n4 and element e1 read it: family-code article 22 proves an unregistered marriage only by a judgment.

question.ar: هل سبق أن صدر حكم بالنفقة بين الطرفين، مع ذكر تاريخه إن وجد؟
question.en: Has a judgment already awarded maintenance between the parties? (Give its date if so.)

slots.why: Boundary n1 and document doc6 read it: family-code article 79 bars revision of an assessment before a year from the judgment. Merges A's maintenance_previously_judged and B's maintenance_judgment_date (the date itself drives no computable rule: the record cannot add a year to a slot).

question.ar: هل المدعى عليه أجنبي الجنسية؟
question.en: Is the defendant of foreign nationality?

slots.why: Boundary n11 reads it: civil-code articles 12, 13 and 14 choose the applicable law by nationality.

question.ar: هل بلغ أحد الأولاد المطالب بنفقتهم سن الرشد؟
question.en: Has any child for whom maintenance is claimed reached majority?

slots.why: Boundary n12 reads it (verifier, attack adv-3): family-code 75 continues maintenance for a studying or disabled child, while family-code 86 and 87 give guardianship over minor children only, and CPCA 13 has the judge raise lack of standing of his own motion.

question.ar: هل توجد بين الزوجين دعوى طلاق أو تطليق أو خلع قائمة لم يفصل فيها؟
question.en: Is a divorce, judicial-divorce or khul action between the spouses pending and not yet decided?

slots.why: Boundary n13 reads it (verifier, attack adv-4): CPCA 442 lets the divorce judge order provisional measures, and CPCA 55 and 56 let a connected case be handed over.
